tools.name: Log Finder
tools.description: Sort a folder of logs by flight controller and see which parameters changed between flights.

tools.name: Hardware Report
tools.description: Overview of the flight controller, sensors, and parameters from a log or a parameter file.

tools.name: Stream Stats
tools.description: Message-rate statistics for DataFlash logs and MAVLink telemetry logs.

tools.name: AI Log Analyzer
tools.description: Ask questions about a log. The model call needs an API key and a network connection.

tools.name: Video Overlay
tools.description: Line a video up with a DataFlash log and export the flight with a telemetry overlay.

tools.name: MAGFit
tools.description: Calibrate the compass from a flight log by fitting it to the world magnetic model.

tools.name: Filter Review
tools.description: Inspect gyro noise and try filter changes against a log you have already flown.

tools.name: PID Review
tools.description: Review rate and attitude PID tracking in the time domain and the frequency domain.

tools.name: Filter Tool
tools.description: Bode plot of gyro low-pass and notch filters loaded from a parameter file.

tools.name: Airspeed Fit
tools.description: Estimate ARSPD_RATIO for each airspeed sensor from a flight log.

tools.name: Analytic Tune
tools.description: Suggest a multirotor or helicopter tune from system-identification data.

tools.name: Thrust Expo
tools.description: Fit MOT_THST_EXPO from thrust-stand data so throttle tracks thrust.

tools.name: Kinematic Tool
tools.description: Explore multirotor attitude-control input shaping. A separate tile opens the plane variant.

tools.name: Kinematic Tool (Plane)
tools.description: Fixed-wing input-shaping view of the kinematic tool.

tools.name: SCurve Tool
tools.description: Plot S-curve navigation trajectories from waypoint and speed parameters.

tools.name: Rotation Check
tools.description: Visualize ArduPilot rotation order and sensor orientation.

tools.name: Geofence Generator
tools.description: Build a geofence from OpenStreetMap waterways. The map tiles themselves need a network connection.

tools.name: SysID
tools.description: Fit a state-space or transfer-function model from a flight log. Extra Python packages download on first use when you are online.

tools.name: Telemetry Dashboard
tools.description: Live MAVLink displays. Connects to a WebSocket such as Mission Planner on this computer.

tools.name: Simple GCS
tools.description: A small example ground station for boats, aimed at an autonomous buoy.

tools.name: DFU Loader
tools.description: Flash an ArduPilot bootloader to a board that is already in USB DFU mode.
